blocks.raw: This auth flow is used when the API requests are made from a program or service running on a server. This flow uses an access token to authenticate an API request. When using OAuth, the API client key and secret key or an access token are used for calling APIs, rather than the user's credentials. This enhances security by avoiding misuse of user's credentials and creates secure pathways for accessing your organization's data via Capillary APIs.

blocks.raw: # Creating API client key and secret
blocks.text: Creating API client key and secret

blocks.raw: API client key and secret can be created from the Authentication page in the organization settings. Refer to documentation [Create an API client key and secret](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/api-client#creating-an-api-client-key-and-secret).
blocks.text: API client key and secret can be created from the Authentication page in the organization settings. Refer to documentation Create an API client key and secret.
Prerequisite : API client key and secret.

blocks.raw: Once you get the key and secret, you can generate an access token or JWT (JSON Web Token) using the token/generate API. JWT is a compact URL and JSON-based used to transfer data securely between two parties.
blocks.text: Once you get the key and secret, you can generate an access token or JWT (JSON Web Token) using the token/generate API. JWT is a compact URL and JSON-based used to transfer data securely between two parties.

blocks.raw:
> 📘 Note
>
> The token validity will be as per the value set for the client (Token expiry duration). If a token expires, you can regenerate it using the same API.

blocks.raw: Once you generate the access token, you can use it to authenticate API calls as shown below.
blocks.text: Once you generate the access token, you can use it to authenticate API calls as shown below.

blocks.raw: Set the authentication to **No Auth** and pass the following headers.
blocks.text: Set the authentication to No Auth and pass the following headers.

blocks.raw:
| Header                                | Value                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| ------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| **X-CAP-API-OAUTH-TOKEN\***           | Generated access token.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| **Content-Type\***                    | This should be set as application/json                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| **Accept\***                          | This should also be set as application/json                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| **X-CAP-API-ATTRIBUTION-ENTITY-TYPE** | Till or store from which you want to post the data. Supported Values: TILL, STORE\_CODE, STORE\_NAME, STORE\_EXTERNAL\_ID, STORE\_EXTERNAL\_ID\_1, STORE\_EXTERNAL\_ID\_2. The default value is TILL.                                                                                      |
| **X-CAP-API-ATTRIBUTION-ENTITY-CODE** | Pass the entity value based on the entity type. For example, if X-CAP-API-ATTRIBUTION-ENTITY-TYPE is STORE\_CODE, then X-CAP-API-ATTRIBUTION-ENTITY-CODE is the store code that you want to tag to POST data. By default, it considers the Till associated with the client key and secret. |
